messages:
darya: opening short change window for convo-service  rolling convo-v3-quant to 18% (canary slices by region). primary checks: p95, p99, 5xx, and downstream timeouts. deploy-bot: rollout started: convo-service -> convo-v3-quant (18%). rollout id r-2026-07-15-03 :rocket:
mike: watching /dash/slo/convo-service. will page if p99 > 400ms or 5xx > 0.35%. :eyes:
jas: FYI I changed batching logic to favor short prompts; might increase variance for long prompts. flagged in release notes.
sentry-bot: perf-smoke: collecting p50/p95/p99 and 5xx by region (30s).
mike: canary p99 ap-south-1 = 422ms (baseline 230ms)  breach. :rotating_light:
jas: seeing 5xx up to 0.5% in that region, traces show long-blocking calls in the preprocessor for long token inputs. linking traces: https://traces.internal/jkl222
darya: hold ramp. do not go to 50%. acknowledge alerts.
mike: quick PromQL for per-region p99: ```query
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{service=\"convo-service\",region=~\".*\"}[1m])) by (le,region))
```
mike: values: ap-south-1=422ms, eu-west-2=240ms, us-east-1=210ms
jas: the new batching favors short prompts so long prompts fall into a slower path that hit a sync call to legacy tokenizer. I can hotpatch to bypass legacy path for canary by flipping ENV USE_LEGACY_TOKENIZER=false.
darya: approve. apply hotpatch and restart canary pods.
jas: running:
```bash
kubectl set env deployment/convo-canary USE_LEGACY_TOKENIZER=false -n prod
kubectl rollout restart deployment/convo-canary -n prod
```
deploy-bot: canary restart detected.
sentry-bot: after restart, ap-south-1 p99 trending to 255ms, 5xx down to 0.09%.
mike: good improvement. suggestion: keep canary at 18% for 35m with the tokenizer bypass. if p99 remains < 300ms and 5xx < 0.25% escalate ramp. if regression returns, we'll pin to convo-v2 and document root cause.
darya: also add a warmup job to exercise long-prompt path before next ramp. create INF-1233. jas file it.
jas: created INF-1233 and added note to release doc: https://docs.internal/releases/convo/2026-07-15.
darya: reminder: pin command if needed: `deployctl pin --service convo-service --version convo-v2 --reason "canary p99 regression/legacy tokenizer"` (immediate failover).
mike: annotating rollout with canary decisions and linking INF-1233. deploy-bot: rollout update: convo-service -> convo-v3-quant at 18% (stable after tokenizer bypass).
darya: thanks team. keeping thread open for 35m. will reconvene then to decide ramp vs pin. :thumbsup:
